title: Haider hu main haider

1 . Suraj mere kehne pe bhala kyu na palata ..

2 . Main gaib hu duniya ko ye idraak nahi hai ..

3 . Hai kab ke sadakat ke hawale mere bis main ..

5 . Jar qatal kiya jaao to main qatal na hunga ..

6 . Puhace sare mairaaj e nabi jis ghadi logo..

7 . Maa ne kabhi marhab ke ye marhab se kaha tha ..

<<DIVIDER>>
Maidan main aajayi agar koi ye kehkar ..

8 . Tu kisko darate ho yu naam apne batake ..

<<DIVIDER>>
Main aam sahabi nahi aayi marhabo antar ..

<<DIVIDER>>
9 . Jo logo samaj thi hai main wallah nahi hu ..
Tum jaan lo sab kuch hu main Allah nahi hu ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Maabud hai Akbar woh mera khalike Akbar .
